name: Planetary Protection & Contamination Control
summary: Keeping Earth life off other worlds, and alien material away from Earth, so that the search for life stays trustworthy.

topics.name: Why planetary protection matters (forward and backward contamination)
COSPAR policy and mission categories I-V
Bioburden: spores, cleanrooms and assay methods
Sterilisation: dry heat, vapour hydrogen peroxide, radiation
Special regions on Mars and icy moons
Sample return containment and restricted Earth return
Case studies: Viking, Mars 2020, Europa Clipper, OSIRIS-REx
